content.short: Millions of people across Africa, Asia and Europe start with crypto on Luno, a simple exchange owned by Digital Currency Group.
content.description: Luno has been introducing people to crypto since 2013, with especially strong markets in South Africa, Nigeria and Malaysia. The main app keeps buying, selling and storing Bitcoin, Ethereum and other assets simple, and a separate pro interface handles active trading. Users can stake for yield and receive payments with Luno Pay. Luno is part of Digital Currency Group and is registered with the UK FCA, among other regulators. It now also offers tokenized stocks, crypto bundles, prediction markets and a business service through BlockTower that lets banks and telecom companies embed regulated crypto access. Luno says it holds all assets one to one and publishes proof of reserves monthly.
content.meta: Simple crypto app for buying, storing and staking, popular across Africa, Asia and Europe. Explore Luno on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
